prompts.electric:
Use case: stylized-concept. DISASSEMBLED PAPER THEATRE KIT, NOT a finished backdrop. New transparent 1536x1024 atlas of SIX physically SEPARATE flat cut-paper pieces for an electric gym popup, matching teal/yellow/copper paper craft of reference. No complete building anywhere. Pieces must have transparent gutters and be independently usable. No floor, no trainers, no Pokeball, no words.
EXACT 3 columns x 2 rows, each piece confined to its cell, at least 35px transparent separation:
TOP LEFT: a plain deep-teal arched wall panel, smooth paper fibers and subtle hand-cut irregular outline, only faint tone-on-tone circuit diagrams, NO pillars, badge, lights, trusses or furniture printed on this backing.
TOP MIDDLE: one LARGE HOLLOW curved roof TRUSS, a thin semicircular arch made from layered teal and cream paper beams, triangular open holes between ribs, completely transparent inside the arch and through openings. No wall behind it.
TOP RIGHT: one hanging garland of copper paper WIRES with THREE small cream paper lamps; the wires stretch horizontally, curves/loops, hanging lamps below; fully isolated, nothing behind.
BOTTOM LEFT: a free-standing asymmetrical cluster of THREE slender yellow paper insulating PILLARS of different heights with a few teal bands, tall narrow silhouette; no wall behind.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: a single isolated ROUND lightning BADGE, dark teal outer cardstock circle, ochre paper ring and yellow flat lightning bolt, tangible stacked paper edges, no wall behind.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a low wide front GATE AND SWITCHBOARD strip, two compact teal cabinets framing an open grid-pattern gate, short yellow rail, no wall or roof above.
Each of these is a SEPARATE CUTOUT with actual alpha transparency. Flat orthographic front view, luxurious fibrous matte colored paper, distinct overlapping thin edges, shallow natural contact shadows. NO 3D thick shapes, no beveled metal, no volumetric model. This is a kit for physically assembling the scene from many depth-separated pieces.
